prompt: Create an original 60 second West African acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: kora, balafon, calabash percussion. Style: interlocking plucked patterns and buoyant polyrhythm. Tempo approximately 118 BPM; C major. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A lively and upbeat instrumental piece with a folk-medieval character, featuring a prominent mandolin melody, harpsichord accompaniment, and light, driving percussion.
description.zh: 一首活泼欢快的器乐曲，具有民间中世纪风格，以突出的曼陀林旋律、大键琴伴奏和轻快有力的打击乐为特色。
